name: What types of toilets are available for installation?

mainEntity.name: What types of toilets are available for installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: There's a wide variety of toilets available, each with different features and designs. Common types include one-piece toilets, which are easier to clean, and two-piece toilets, which are generally more affordable. You can also choose between standard round-front bowls, which save space, or elongated bowls, which offer more comfort. Other options include dual-flush toilets for water conservation, comfort-height (ADA compliant) toilets for easier use, and wall-mounted toilets for a modern look and easier floor cleaning. Alpha-Plumbing Services can help you select the best type for your bathroom and needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Toilet types include one-piece, two-piece, round-front, elongated, dual-flush, and comfort-height, each offering different benefits and aesthetics.
